sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The [[Huntik Foundation]] team reached the mausoleum of [[Sir Lancelot]], but they were unaware that Rassimov was right behind them. [[Dante Vale]] and [[Lok Lambert]] managed to reach the treasure with a little help from Rassimov, but Rassimov ambushed them and almost acquired the treasure. When Sir Lancelot's Titan, [[Cavalier]], would not bond with him, Rassimov used the power of [[Darkvoid]] to destroy the Titan and the treasures. However the team find the instructions for the power [[Findshape]]. {{source|Memory Lane}}
[[Category:Huntik Foundation Missions]]
